label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**Dear Larkspur Lofts Residents,**

I’m writing to address concerns about the drone I flew from the roof deck and the note subsequently posted in the lobby identifying my unit.

At about 4:00 p.m. on Saturday, October 31, I flew my new Halvard Mini 4 for approximately 11 minutes. As a wedding photographer, I was testing the drone before using it at a vineyard wedding in Dundee. Throughout the flight, the camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge. It was never directed at anyone’s windows, and I was not attempting to observe or record residents.

I understand why an unfamiliar drone buzzing and hovering above the courtyard could be unsettling, especially without knowing who was operating it or why. A neighbor told me that her grandchildren were frightened when they saw it, and I’m sorry for that. I sincerely apologize for the worry and discomfort my flight caused.

At the same time, having my unit number posted in the lobby alongside an accusation that I was spying and the word “creep” was hurtful and felt exposing. I recognize that the underlying concern may have been sincere, but publicly labeling me was not an appropriate or constructive way to raise it. If you have a concern about something I’m doing in the future, please come speak with me directly.

I am happy to show the full, unedited footage to any resident who would like to see exactly what was recorded. You’re welcome to knock on my door at 5A or email me at **jess.okafor@mailbox.example** to arrange a time.

My understanding is that the current HOA rules do not address drones. I will not fly from the roof again unless and until the board establishes a rule permitting it. I will ask the board to add a discussion of drone use to the agenda for the meeting on **November 19 at 7:00 p.m. in the community room**, and I encourage anyone with concerns or suggestions to attend.

I’ve lived at Larkspur Lofts for three years and value being part of this community. I hope we can address this directly and respectfully.

Sincerely,  
**Jess Okafor**  
Unit 5A
